title: GGIpack2: generic genome interrogation support
text: package addresses tasks integrating interrogating diverse aspects structural functional aspects genomes, initial focus genome Homo sapiens. show integrate information GTEx (v7) Ensembl (v75) using resources package Bioconductor’s annotation facilities.

title: GGIpack2: generic genome interrogation support
text: following example shows obtain slice data GTEx eQTL data relating SNP genotypes gene expression whole blood. package example data eQTLs based RNA-seq analysis whole blood samples. example data 500 records GTEx v7 summaries, filtered keep SNP loci test association rare allele count nearby gene nominal p-value less 0.05.

what: Set up database connection and construct the interface
title: GGIpack2: generic genome interrogation support
text: First define path parquet file. Second, set duckdb connection facilitate use SQL-like querying data. Third, use GTExresource constructor create systematic interface querying. helper method getdb simplifies direct access table.
